caption: The drawing features a detailed sketch of a child's dress and related garment components on a light beige background, rendered primarily in pencil with slight blueish shading. At the center, there is a front view of a short-sleeved dress with lace trim around the collar and sleeves, vertical detailing down the chest, and three horizontal rows of stitching above the lower hem. Above the dress, two lace or embroidery pattern samples are displayed; one is a scalloped lace edging, and the other shows a rectangular insert with floral embroidery flanked by mesh panels. To the right of the dress, there is a sketch of a sleeveless garment top with lace-trimmed armholes and neckline. Below the dress, the drawing includes a rear view of the short-sleeved dress showing a tie closure at the back, and to its right, a band of lace with a zigzag edge. Written measurements are present beside most garments and laces, and the composition is clean and technical, focusing on the garment construction details. The only color suggested is from the pencil and shading, indicating dimensionality, without any vivid hues.
title: Infant's Dress and Shirt
